visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short dark hair, wearing a black mask and a black hoodie with a small white cross logo, stands on a dimly lit street corner at night. He holds a small packet in his hands and looks towards the camera, then away. Behind him, a green traffic light glows against the dark sky, and a white car is visible in the distance on the wet asphalt road. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a brightly lit shrimp fishing venue. The male character sits by a large rectangular concrete pool filled with dark, rippling water. He is holding a white and green fishing rod, gesturing with his hands as he talks. Other patrons are seated around the pool, and yellow claw machines are visible in the background against green and orange walls. (3) A middle-aged man in a red t-shirt and blue jeans walks along the edge of the pool, carrying a white bucket. He tosses small, pale objects into the water, presumably shrimp or bait, creating small splashes. The main character watches this action while holding his fishing rod steady. (4) The main character focuses on the water, his fishing rod dipped into the pool. He gestures excitedly towards the camera while wearing his black mask. He eventually pulls the rod up, revealing a small shrimp caught on the hook. He holds it up briefly before placing it in a container. (5) The character leans over the edge of the pool, pointing his finger at a specific spot in the water. He reaches in with his bare hand and successfully grabs a shrimp. He stands up and displays the live shrimp to the camera, holding it by its antennae before it wriggles and falls back into the water, causing him to react with a shrug.
